crossRefs.note: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?
Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where…
crossRefs.keyword: is turned into joy. Heb. rejoiceth

crossRefs.note: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
crossRefs.keyword: is turned into joy. Heb. rejoiceth

translations.web: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
translations.bsb: Strength resides in his neck, and dismay leaps before him.
translations.kjv: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before
translations.asv: In his neck abideth strength, And terror danceth before him.
